messages.subject: Project Lumen - execution versions and completion on 15 March
messages.plaintextBody:
Rachel,

Execution versions attached: the SPA, the Investor Rights Agreement and the side letter. These reflect everything agreed - 75% cap, 15-month survival, 18-month non-compete, de minimis 17.5% / Threshold GBP 150,000, and the MAC at 3.1.7 unqualified.

We'd like to complete on Friday 15 March. Please arrange for the company and both founders to execute via the platform, and confirm the disclosure letter is final.

Best,
James

--

messages.subject: RE: Project Lumen - COMPLETED
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

Project Lumen has completed. The SPA, Investor Rights Agreement and side letter were executed this morning and the GBP 12,000,000 subscription has been funded against issue of the 3,000,000 Series B shares. Executed SPA attached for the file. For the record, the executed positions are: warrantor cap 75% of the Investment Amount, 15-month survival, 18-month founder non-compete, de minimis 17.5% / Threshold GBP 150,000, and an unqualified MAC at clause 3.1.7.

Thanks all for a smooth close.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
